comment_repeatable: Oblivion native attached-point-light animation. lightFlags_7C bits 0x08/0x40 select Flicker/Flicker Slow and bits 0x80/0x100 select Pulse/Pulse Slow; the slow variants reduce the update step. It updates NiLight position and m_fDimmer using AttachedLightPayload_Decoded::targetDimmer_04 and TESObjectLIGH::fade_88. This is source-light state animation, not shadow-caster admission.
